facts: Thea Residences 2 is the second phase of the Thea Residences complex in Deryneia, Famagusta district, built next to the completed first phase (Thea 1, delivered and sold out) on a corner plot beside the municipal amphitheatre.

The building has five apartments with two apartments per floor: a ground/first-floor maisonette with a 56 m² garden, three two-bedroom apartments on the first to third floors, and a second/third-floor penthouse maisonette with a 24.7 m² roof garden.
The two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartments (nos. 2, 3 and 4) have 78 m² of internal area; apartment 3 on the second floor has a 17.1 m² covered veranda, nos. 2 and 4 have 15.8 m².
Construction is in progress; the price list gives the stage as TILING.

External walls are 25 cm clay thermal bricks with an external thermal insulation system; windows and sliding doors are dark grey thermally broken aluminium (MU3000/MU2075 series) with double glazing; balustrades are 16 mm laminated glass.

Kitchens have high-quality laminate units (allowance up to €230/m) with soft-close mechanisms and granite worktops; bathrooms have concealed wall-hung WCs; a choice of three finish palettes (white, beige, grey) is offered.
The building is served by one KONE lift; a roof photovoltaic system serves the communal areas and each private parking space has an EV charging provision.
Hot water comes from a roof solar system with an 800-litre tank, 200-litre cylinder and 1.9 m² collectors, with a provision for a hot-water recirculation pump.

The developer states: park 100 m, amphitheatre 145 m, primary school 200 m, supermarket 460 m, post office 470 m, Ammochostos (Famagusta) General Hospital 500 m, Kapparis Beach 4 km, Malama Beach 4.5 km, Kalamies Beach 7 km, Konnos Beach 13 km, Larnaca Airport 38 km.
